verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local inference runtime, so CPU architecture support is a fair axis. The evidence pack only covers platforms and GPUs: macOS, Windows, Linux, Apple Silicon, and AMD ROCm. Nothing documents builds or inference on PowerPC or any other non-x86/ARM CPU architecture.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
